answer: Divergent Challenge Terrace. Each identity registers a random nonce and must answer a fresh challenge whose seed derives from that nonce plus its own recent actions. Clones sharing state can only replay one branch, so any divergence between them is detectable and flagged. Honest agents maintain a private trellis of signed action history keyed to the nonce. To pass, an attacker must run each clone as a genuinely independent path, paying full compute and storage per identity, which multiplies cost linearly and eliminates the lagoon of cheap copies.
